name.local: ヤマウチ・ナンバーテン・ファミリー・オフィス

strategy.thesis: The family office of Nintendo's founding (Yamauchi) family invests its inherited capital into deep tech, healthcare, space and creative-industry companies that use cutting-edge technology to address major social issues. It takes a long-term, patient approach, willing to wait over a decade for turnaround results.

application.how_to_apply: Direct relationships; not a public application process.

summary.en: The single-family office of Nintendo's founding Yamauchi family, launched in 2020 by Banjo Yamauchi. It manages over 100 billion yen and invests patient, long-term capital into deep tech, healthcare, space and creative-industry startups (e.g. Astroscale, NOT A HOTEL) aiming to revitalize Japan.
summary.local: 任天堂創業家・山内家のファミリーオフィス。2020年に山内万丈氏が設立し、1,000億円超を運用。短期的な資産増大よりも社会に貢献する事業を重視し、ディープテック・ヘルスケア・宇宙・クリエイティブ領域のスタートアップに長期的視点で投資する。

strategy.thesis: Founded as a family-office-structured investor by Taizo Son (youngest brother of SoftBank's Masayoshi Son) to back tech entrepreneurs solving global social and sustainability challenges in health, education, transportation, food and more. The family office structure was deliberately chosen to make 'radical' impact investments without relying on outside private capital.

application.how_to_apply: Network-based; invests in and supports startups and venture capitals via its ecosystem.

summary.en: Mistletoe was founded in 2013 by serial entrepreneur Taizo Son (GungHo founder, brother of Masayoshi Son) as a family-office-structured investor for positive-impact startups. It has invested roughly $400 million across about 170 startups (including Garena/Sea, which IPO'd). In 2023 Son and director Atsushi Taira spun out The Edgeof, which acquired SoftBank Ventures Asia.
summary.local: ミスルトウは2013年に連続起業家・孫泰蔵氏(ガンホー創業者、孫正義氏の弟)がファミリーオフィス型の投資主体として設立。社会課題解決・ポジティブインパクトを掲げ、約170社・総額約4億ドルを投資(上場したGarena/Seaを含む)。2023年に同氏らはThe Edgeofを設立し、SoftBank Ventures Asiaを買収した。

strategy.thesis: A 1912-founded Osaka real-estate company owned by the Shibakawa family, operating as a family office investor in startups. It invests primarily in middle- to later-stage startups that can compete globally or lead the domestic market, judging by social impact, business potential and concrete growth strategy. It explicitly does not impose fund time limits and treats IPO as a milestone, not an exit.

application.how_to_apply: Direct relationships; see startup page on corporate site.

summary.en: Chishima Real Estate is a Shibakawa-family company founded in 1912 in Osaka that, alongside its real-estate business, operates as a family office investing in startups. It positions itself explicitly as a family office (not a time-limited VC/CVC fund), backing mainly middle/later-stage startups such as Luup, akippa and EX-Fusion, with IPO exits including Microwave Chemical and Kringle Pharma.
summary.local: 千島土地は1912年創業の大阪の芝川家系企業で、不動産事業と並行してファミリーオフィスとしてスタートアップ投資を行う。ファンド期限を設けず、ミドル～レイターステージのスタートアップ(Luup、akippa、EX-Fusionなど)に出資。マイクロ波化学やクリングルファーマなどのIPO実績を持つ。

name.local: 日高ファミリーオフィス

strategy.thesis: A single-family office in Tokyo led by CIO Nobuyuki Hidaka (ex-Mitsubishi, Goldman Sachs, Lehman Brothers) that sources and structures direct investments and co-investments across venture capital, private equity and real estate, both domestically and abroad, deploying patient multi-generational capital into early- to growth-stage businesses.

summary.en: A Tokyo-based single-family office led by CIO Nobuyuki Hidaka (ex-Mitsubishi, Goldman Sachs, Lehman Brothers). It directly makes and co-invests in venture capital, private equity and real estate, deploying patient multi-generational capital into early- to growth-stage businesses in Japan and abroad. It is one of the few Japanese family offices explicitly active in VC.
summary.local: 東京を拠点とするシングルファミリーオフィス。CIOの日高信之氏(三菱、ゴールドマン・サックス、リーマン・ブラザーズ出身)が率い、ベンチャーキャピタル・プライベートエクイティ・不動産に直接投資/共同投資する。日本のVC領域で活動する数少ないファミリーオフィスの一つ。

current_fund.raw: 総額100億円規模 (~10 billion yen)

strategy.thesis: Personal investment company set up by ZOZO founder Yusaku Maezawa to deploy his personal assets into entrepreneurs and organizations tackling social challenges or pursuing passion-driven ventures, supporting them from a position close to a managing shareholder using know-how from ZOZO.

notable_investments.company: Fish Bio Tech (フィッシュ・バイオテック)

application.how_to_apply: Ran a public open-call program ('10 entrepreneurs, 10 billion yen') in 2020 with 4,331 applications; now selective.

summary.en: Maezawa Fund is a personal investment company founded in February 2020 by ZOZO founder Yusaku Maezawa to invest roughly 10 billion yen (~100億円) of his own assets into entrepreneurs solving social problems or pursuing passions. Its '10 entrepreneurs, 10 billion yen' open call drew 4,331 applications and selected 14 companies (e.g. ARIGATOBANK, Toletta, ANGLERS). Maezawa later launched the MZ Web3 Fund (2022).
summary.local: 前澤ファンドはZOZO創業者・前澤友作氏が2020年2月に設立した個人の投資会社。社会課題解決や趣味の追求を掲げる起業家に対し、前澤氏の個人資産をもとに総額100億円規模を出資する。「10人の起業家に100億円」企画には4,331件の応募があり14社に出資。2022年にはMZ Web3ファンドも設立した。

name.local: テラシアス・キャピタル

strategy.thesis: A Tokyo single-family office founded in 2012 managing the Yamanaka family's assets, led by Ikuko Yamanaka (long career in investment banking in London, Singapore and Tokyo). It is focused primarily on alternative investments — private equity, hedge funds, private credit, real estate, natural resources and IP — and is reported to engage in some private-equity / venture-style direct investing.

summary.en: Terrasias Capital is a Tokyo single-family office founded in 2012 to manage the Yamanaka family's assets, led by Ikuko Yamanaka (ex-RBS, ABN AMRO, JP Morgan, Bear Stearns). It focuses on alternative investments — PE, hedge funds, private credit, real estate, natural resources and IP — and is listed in directories as engaging in some PE/VC-style direct investing, though startup activity is not emphasized on its own site.
summary.local: テラシアス・キャピタルは2012年設立の東京のシングルファミリーオフィスで、山中家の資産を運用する。山中郁子氏(RBS、ABN AMRO、JPモルガン、ベア・スターンズ出身)が率い、プライベートエクイティ・ヘッジファンド・プライベートクレジット・不動産・天然資源・知的財産などのオルタナティブ投資を中心とする。
